import re
from collections import Counter

def top_k_frequent_words(text: str, k: int) -> list[str]:
    if k <= 0 or not text:
        return []
    
    # Extract words and count their frequencies case-insensitively
    words = re.findall(r'\b\w+\b', text.lower())
    word_counts = Counter(words)
    
    # Get the top k most frequent words
    top_k = word_counts.most_common(k)
    
    # Sort by frequency descending and then alphabetically ascending
    top_k.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))
    
    # Extract the words from the sorted list
    result = [word for word, count in top_k]
    
    return result

import re

def generate_slug(title: str, max_length: int = 50) -> str:
    if not title:
        return ""
    
    # Lowercase all ASCII characters
    title = title.lower()
    
    # Replace any run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen '-'
    title = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', title)
    
    # Trim leading and trailing hyphens
    title = title.strip('-')
    
    # If length exceeds max_length, truncate to at most max_length characters
    if len(title) > max_length:
        if '-' in title[max_length:]:
            # Find the last hyphen before the max_length
            last_hyphen_index = title[:max_length].rfind('-')
            if last_hyphen_index != -1:
                title = title[:last_hyphen_index]
        else:
            title = title[:max_length]
    
    # Strip any trailing hyphen
    title = title.rstrip('-')
    
    return title

        self.assertEqual(evaluate_simple_expression("3/2"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(evaluate_simple_expression(" 3 + 5 / 2 "), 5)

    def test_division_by_zero(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ZeroDivisionError):
            evaluate_simple_expression("5 / 0")
        with self.assertRaises(ZeroDivisionError):
            evaluate_simple_expression("0 / 5")

    def test_single_number(self):
        self.assertEqual(evaluate_simple_expression("42"), 42)

    def test_empty_string(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            evaluate_simple_expression("")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
